body:
> Guide · Summit Az · 2026-10-08

# Summary
The binding project instructions loaded in every Summit Arizona Claude Code session. It consolidates Scott's SEO tool decision (Sep 5, 2026) and Kim's permanent SEO system rule (Sep 9), plus the homepage lock, business content guardrails and standing rules. Last updated Oct 8, 2026 (homepage one-time exception). Older copies exist as `CLAUDE.md.bak` (Sep 9), `CLAUDE.md.bak-premerge-20260909-022744` and `CLAUDE.md.bak-20261001`; `README.md` is a one-line placeholder.

# Key rules
1. **Rank Math is the only implementation system** for focus keywords, titles, metas, canonicals, robots, sitemaps, schema, OG tags and redirects. Yoast stays inactive; never run both.
2. **Search Atlas and OTTO are analysis only** (audits, keyword research, rank tracking, GSC/GA4 analysis, review-only recommendations).
3. Search Atlas, OTTO and MetaSync must never deploy, rewrite content, change headings, insert hidden text, change links, titles, schema, canonicals or robots, or override Rank Math.
4. **Approval gates:** OTTO stays in manual review, Autopilot off, never "Deploy All". Show Kim the exact change and get approval before any deploy.
5. **OTTO activation safety procedure:** the pixel makes every previously deployed fix live at once, so list deployments, flag bad ones and stop if enabling the crawler would activate them.
6. Delivery state: OTTO pixel is Code Snippets ID 23; disabling it removes OTTO. Crawling does not need the pixel.
7. On conflicts Rank Math wins; report rather than let Search Atlas override. Do not touch layouts, copy, forms, phones, tracking or Rank Math unless the task authorizes it.

# Homepage lock
- Scott's rule (Sep 7): do not touch the homepage (`/`, page 4752). Report only.
- One-time exception Oct 8 ("Yes, Scott approved"): mobile duplicate H1 set to H2 (widget 81f0aaa), meta description shortened to 154 characters, default Article schema turned off for the page.

# Business guardrails
- 15 approved services (items 1 to 9 approved Sep 5, items 10 to 15 approved by Kim the same day; Scott said "yes to all" on Sep 25).
- Hours Mon to Sat 8 to 5, closed Sunday; no holiday-hours or 24/7 claims.
- Never invent services, areas, prices, discounts, warranties, certifications, years, 24/7, reviews or project examples. Never deploy hidden text, stuffing, generic headings, duplicate metadata, conflicting schema or city-swap copy.

# Standing rules (recorded Oct 1)
- OTTO pixel and MetaSync stay OFF. GBP (location 93167) is read only. /repiping/ is off the list. Residential only, no prices.
- GA4 AZ is 459518259; 529636373 is Utah.
- Never delete pages, posts, artifacts or WP Trash, and do not offer to.
- Google Ads 140-101-3750: no changes without Kim's explicit go per change.
- Files were reorganized Oct 1 (moved only); see [Organization Log 2026-10-01](lib:brain-organization-log-2026-10-01).
